notes:
• Press T anywhere in the app to search all tickets, or O to search clients, without leaving what you're on.
• Tickets now open beside the list everywhere, and Keep as tab pins one open.
• The ticket page reads in the order you use it: the title, then Book time, then the time on the ticket, then notes.
• If you cover someone's ticket, Time on this ticket now shows everyone's work on it, with the exact total.
• My time has one Add button at the top, next to the new Weekends switch, which shows Saturday and Sunday when you want them.
• The arrow keys and Return now work in My tickets and Clients, and Settings lists every keyboard shortcut.
• On Windows, the Mac's shortcuts now work with Ctrl: Ctrl+F for All tickets, Ctrl+W to close a tab, and Ctrl+1 to 9 for the sidebar.
• Every screen now says what it's for, and empty screens say what to do next.
• Lists and toolbars stay readable when the window is narrow or the text is large.
